records.localization_note: Hodram Bergstrom is the installed short nameplate. The full-name substitution remains Hodram Joakim Bergstrom.
Lil Argot is the approved company captain. Her challenge and bargaining keep her own direct voice.
Camille Overijssel is the approved name. Camille tries to de-escalate Lil's argument and leaves with her.
Gerhard Adernkatz is the established officer name. He formally asks Hodram to address the crew.
Charles Rochefort is the established officer name. He relays the warning and comments on the fleet budget.
Manuel Almeida is the established officer name. His dry proverb follows Hodram's reaction to Lil.
William Clive is the established personal name. His curses come after capture, with no added title.
Hernan Berio is the established personal name. He tries to save face after defeat.
Iscal Yasar is the established personal name. Both cries retain the same speaker and portrait.
Port Worker is the localized source role. His traffic and territorial advice give no distinct rank or proper name.
